project: album-price-third-reader (fix list #62) - 40 holes in A001-A016 where Grok and Gemini prices disagree most
basis: Third independent prices. CoinStudy charts state their values are wholesale, computed from dealer price lists (updated 2026-10-26, silver $54.05/oz); the 1916-D VG8 price is a single Heritage realised auction result (Mar 2026). No price copied from the Grok (Numista) or Gemini (USA Coin Book) files.

totals.note: The 1916-D Heritage result ($2,751) is 73% of the 40-hole total; treat totals without it as the stable figure.

items.label: 1916-D
items.source: Heritage Auctions realised price, 2026 March 26-28 U.S. Coins Signature Auction #1391, lot 7067: 1916-D Mercury dime, PCGS VG8, sold $2,751 (auction record as listed on PCGS Auction Prices, Mercury Dime 1916-D page https://www.pcgs.com/auctionprices/details/1916-d-ms/4907 ) - single certified sale, not a guide price
